summary: Senior Software Engineer and Systems Developer with extensive experience building scalable test infrastructure, automated pipelines, and cloud-backed applications. Highly proficient in Python, TypeScript, and C, with recent focus on AI-assisted development, full-stack tools, and cloud integrations. Adept at designing robust backend services, data pipelines, and containerized or emulated environments.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Developed full-stack web applications and AI-powered tools using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Built custom AI suites integrating Google Cloud Vertex AI, Google Gemini, and Cloud Firestore for backend processing and intelligent data handling.
Engineered backend services and modular applications leveraging Rust (Axum, Shuttle.rs) and TypeScript.
Leveraged modern AI-assisted development workflows and automated testing frameworks including Vitest and Playwright.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Developed automated testing and verification infrastructure for medical point-of-care test instruments using Python.
Implemented complete remote access frameworks for continuous integration and continuous target testing.
Created comprehensive API reference documentation using Sphinx extensions and internal web hosting.
Configured robust testing protocols covering device USB updates, firmware verification, and hardware integration.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Developed a highly object-oriented test framework in Python 2.7 for automotive firmware update testing.
Built test execution architectures that mediated between cloud servers and vehicular hardware to verify updates and analyze logs.
Implemented concurrent application log following, stop-on-fail control, and dynamic test procedures using YAML configuration files.
Utilized Linux utilities, SSH, and automated tooling within GitLab and Jira environments.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Developed hardware and software configurations for standalone production test stations using Python 2.7 and Debian Linux.
Wrote all analog and digital control software for BeagleBone Black microcomputers managing power, calibration, tach/RPM, and temperature sensors.
Created telemetry event data log visualizations using numpy, pandas, and matplotlib over time-series data streams.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned test data and synchronized environmental data collection with system-level tests.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Designed timing calibration modules for digital ATE instruments using C++ and Python.
Generated custom digital pin patterns in XML using custom Python scripting automation.
Co-designed parallel, binary search object applications for high-performance test systems.
